Class WaitingList

java.lang.Object
domain.WaitingList
public final class WaitingList extends Object
Represents the restaurant waiting list.

This class manages walk-in customers who arrive without a reservation. It follows the Singleton design pattern and maintains a FIFO queue of waiting parties.

Responsibilities include:

  • Adding and removing guests from the waiting list
  • Notifying the next party when a table is available
  • Validating arrival times and handling late arrivals
  • Providing waiting list data to the client

  • Method Details

    • join

      public int join(Guest guest, Integer partySize)
      Adds a guest to the waiting list.

      The guest must provide at least one contact detail (phone or email), and cannot already exist in the waiting list.

      Parameters:
      guest - the arriving Guest
      partySize - number of people in the party
      Returns:
      a unique waiting ID (verification code)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if input validation fails

      public Guest notifyPartyHead()
      Notifies the next party in the queue that a table is available.

      Sets the notification timestamp if the party has not already been notified.

    • confirmArrival

      public Guest confirmArrival(int waitingId, int maxLateMinutes)
      Confirms the arrival of a party using its verification code.

      The arrival must occur within the allowed late time limit.

      Parameters:
      waitingId - the verification code
      maxLateMinutes - maximum allowed lateness
      Returns:
      the Guest if arrival is valid, or null otherwise
